html: ➜ chaperone pnpm demo:dry # local sandbox, no keys
SWARM: two agents share one vault, each with its own caps
> researcher (max 2 USDC per payment, 5 per day) buys a 2 USDC data sample
agent -> chaperone_pay(recipient=vendor.sandbox, amount=2 USDC, memo=sample)
checker verdict: ALLOW score=0 reasons=[ALLOWLISTED, KNOWN_COUNTERPARTY, NO_SPEND_HISTORY]
vault decision: ALLOW transfer=settled request=3 agent=researcher 2 USDC -> vendor.sandbox
reason codes: ALLOWLISTED, KNOWN_COUNTERPARTY, NO_SPEND_HISTORY
> researcher tries 3 USDC: above its own per-payment cap, though the buyer's cap would allow it
agent -> chaperone_pay(recipient=vendor.sandbox, amount=3 USDC, memo=sample-2)
checker verdict: WARN score=30 reasons=[ALLOWLISTED, KNOWN_COUNTERPARTY, AMOUNT_SPIKE]
vault decision: BLOCK request=4 agent=researcher 3 USDC -> vendor.sandbox
reason codes: RISK_WARN, ALLOWLISTED, KNOWN_COUNTERPARTY, AMOUNT_SPIKE, PER_TX_CAP
> Result: the researcher is held to its own limits.
KILL SWITCH: revoke_all
> owner calls revoke_all: policy version bumps, parked requests are cancelled, agent keys are deleted
agents revoked: 2
> buyer tries to pay 1 USDC with its old key
agent -> chaperone_pay(recipient=vendor.sandbox, amount=1 USDC)
checker verdict: ALLOW score=0 reasons=[ALLOWLISTED, KNOWN_COUNTERPARTY]
network refused the transaction: Access key ed25519:Ee6HGEkdjtVFjTzv35VReNG1h63GuZRWGpyZxMUx4ezu does not exist on account vault.sandbox
> Result: the agent's key no longer exists; it cannot even sign.
